steps.title: Make the filling
steps.body: Beat together **2 Tbsp flour**, **⅛ tsp salt**, **¾ cup sugar**, **1 egg**, **1 cup sour cream**, **1 tsp vanilla** and **¼ tsp nutmeg**. Fold in **2 cups sliced peeled apples**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make the nut topping
steps.body: Meanwhile, cut together nut topping: **¼ cup sugar**, **¼ cup flour**, **¾ tsp cinnamon**, **¼ cup chopped nuts** and **¼ cup butter** (no substitutes).

steps.title: Top and finish
steps.body: Remove pie from oven after 30 minutes at 350°F, top with nut topping, then bake 10 minutes more.
